description: GifSnap 0.1.1 Foundation API client and native SwiftUI GIF picker. Canonical repository: https://github.com/rowixgroup/gifsnap-swift.
rules: Install SwiftPM package https://github.com/rowixgroup/gifsnap-swift.git from version 0.1.1. Products and modules are exactly GifSnap and GifSnapUI.
Import GifSnap for GifSnapGif and GifSnapClient. Import GifSnapUI for GifSnapPicker. Preserve these spellings; use the authored README or docs/quickstart.md if snippets conflict.
GifSnapPicker(theme: .system, mediaType: .gif, pageSize: 24) { gif in ... } passes a GifSnapGif to the selection callback. Use gif.url for the full animated media URL.
The SwiftUI picker requires iOS 16 or later. It uses an animation-capable native image view; AsyncImage alone does not animate GIFs. The API currently needs no key and has no published SLA.
